name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if', so no Existence(at_exit) is warranted; Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) alone states that the exit may not be reached before the switch was toggled. The rule-only warning is valid, as the task imposes a restriction without an unconditional hard goal.

texts: If the exit is reached, the switch must have been toggled first.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
